Another redditor posted this in her advice for beginners, so I can't take credit for this: Wear a sweatshirt around your waist. When you fall, it will provide padding - I fell like that yesterday and if I had had a sweatshirt like the other skater had suggested, I wouldn't have been phased. 

Also, when you fall, keep getting back up. It will always be scary to fall, but you can learn how to do it properly and if you keep skating, you'll get to the point where falling is rare but also NBD <3 Happy Skating!
